## Privacy check

- [ ] The title, body, commits, branch name, release notes, logs, screenshots,
      attachments, and artifact metadata contain no customer/prospect or
      organization names, contact details, account/session identifiers,
      private tracker keys, support details, private repository/internal-tool
      links, or build-machine identity.
- [ ] Any externally reported behavior is described anonymously and its
      identifying context remains only in the private tracker.
